name: Volleyball

ball.note: multi-colour ball, often high in the frame; the net is a fixed landmark

ace.label: Serve that wins the point outright

rally_won.label: Long rally (6+ contacts per side) won by our team

dig_to_kill.label: Dig that leads to a kill

set_to_kill.label: Set that leads to a kill (setter reels)

block_touch.label: Block touch that slows the attack

serve_receive.label: Perfect pass on serve receive (recruiting tape only)

signals: all six same-shirt players converging in a huddle (point won)
players walking back to serve positions (dead time begins)

kit_exceptions: the LIBERO wears a different colour from teammates — calibrate it as a separate kit if the player is a libero
notes: hair is usually tied back, so ponytail/braid colour and length still help
knee pads, shoes and arm sleeves are secondary cues
players rotate: position on court changes every point

social_reel.teaser: best kill frozen at the hand-ball contact
social_reel.finale: the same rally in full with the celebration

order: primary skill for the position (attacking / setting / passing-defense)

season_reel.source: best clips from the player's games this season
